# Achievements

<!-- generated by docs/gen_achievements.py, do not edit by hand -->

pg_achievements ships 46 builtin achievements. Each one is unlocked when a counter of the role reaches the threshold; the counters are described in the [README](../README.md#counters). Secret achievements show `???` instead of the description in `achievements.progress` until they are unlocked.

## Bronze — 10 points, first steps

| Code | Title | Description | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hello_world` | Hello, World | Run your first SELECT. | `stmt_select` ≥ 1 |
| `welcome` | Welcome | Connect to the server for the first time. | `connect` ≥ 1 |
| `first_table` | First Table | Create your first table. | `create_table` ≥ 1 |
| `first_index` | Indexer | Create your first index. | `create_index` ≥ 1 |
| `first_function` | Functionary | Create your first function or procedure. | `create_function` ≥ 1 |
| `first_cte` | WITH Love | Run a query with a common table expression. | `cte_any` ≥ 1 |
| `first_join` | All Connected | Run a query with an explicit JOIN. | `join_count_max` ≥ 1 |
| `first_explain` | Investigator | Ask the planner with EXPLAIN. | `explain_any` ≥ 1 |
| `typo_apprentice` | Learning from Typos | Make 10 syntax errors. | `err_syntax` ≥ 10 |
| `star_gazer` | Stargazer | Run 100 queries with SELECT *. | `select_star` ≥ 100 |
| `night_owl` | Night Owl | Run a query between 03:00 and 05:00. | `night_query` ≥ 1 |
| `null_not_equal` | NULL Is Not Equal to NULL | Compare with = NULL instead of IS NULL. | `null_eq` ≥ 1 |

## Silver — 25 points, mastering PostgreSQL features

| Code | Title | Description | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `detective` | Detective | Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE. | `explain_analyze` ≥ 1 |
| `recursion` | Recursion: See Recursion | Run a WITH RECURSIVE query. | `cte_recursive` ≥ 1 |
| `open_window` | Open Window | Use a window function. | `window_func` ≥ 1 |
| `lateral_thinking` | Lateral Thinking | Use LATERAL. | `lateral` ≥ 1 |
| `jsonb_juggler` | JSONB Juggler | Use the JSONB operators ->, ->>, @> or ? 10 times. | `jsonb_ops` ≥ 10 |
| `patient` | Patient | Wait for a query that runs longer than a minute. | `query_over_60s` ≥ 1 |
| `no_locks` | No Locks | Create an index CONCURRENTLY. | `create_index_concurrently` ≥ 1 |
| `trigger_happy` | Trigger Happy | Create a trigger. | `create_trigger` ≥ 1 |
| `divide_and_conquer` | Divide and Conquer | Create a partitioned table or a partition. | `partition_create` ≥ 1 |
| `extender` | Expanding Horizons | Create 3 extensions. | `create_extension` ≥ 3 |
| `thousand_and_one` | A Thousand and One Queries | Run 1001 SELECT statements. | `stmt_select` ≥ 1001 |
| `night_regular` | Night Shift | Run 20 queries between 03:00 and 05:00. | `night_query` ≥ 20 |
| `star_veteran` | Star Veteran | Run 1000 queries with SELECT *. | `select_star` ≥ 1000 |
| `bronze_collector` | Collector | Collect every bronze achievement. | every builtin bronze achievement |

## Gold — 50 points, risky and rare events

| Code | Title | Description | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `forgot_where` | Forgot WHERE | UPDATE without a WHERE clause. | `update_no_where` ≥ 1 |
| `forgot_where_again` | Forgot WHERE, Part 2 | DELETE without a WHERE clause. | `delete_no_where` ≥ 1 |
| `mutual_understanding` | Mutual Understanding | Take part in a deadlock. | `deadlock` ≥ 1 |
| `friday_deploy` | Friday Deploy | Run DDL on a Friday after 18:00. | `ddl_friday_evening` ≥ 1 |
| `index_for_the_weak` | Indexes Are for the Weak | Scan a table of a million rows sequentially. | `seqscan_big` ≥ 1 |
| `executioner` | Executioner | Call pg_terminate_backend. | `terminate_backend` ≥ 1 |
| `clean_slate` | Clean Slate | TRUNCATE a table. | `truncate` ≥ 1 |
| `table_owner` | Master of the Table | Run VACUUM FULL. | `vacuum_full` ≥ 1 |
| `serial_conflict` | Conflict of Interest | Hit a serialization failure. | `serialization_failure` ≥ 1 |
| `many_joins` | JOINs Without Borders | Run a query with 8 JOINs. | `join_count_max` ≥ 8 |
| `table_collector` | Table Collector | Create 100 tables. | `create_table` ≥ 100 |
| `deadlock_veteran` | Deadlock Veteran | Take part in 5 deadlocks. | `deadlock` ≥ 5 |
